description: Adds a safe npm-global Claude compatibility link for codeagent-wrapper, moves Pi skills to the shared `.agents/skills/` root, ports update-safety fixes, and includes planning/session, channel-context, localization, workspace-journal, platform-template, and marketplace improvements merged since 0.6.17.
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- feat(install): safely create `~/.claude/bin/codeagent-wrapper` during supported npm global installs without overwriting existing custom/live wrappers
- feat(brainstorm,hooks): adopt the stricter Planning Contract and adaptive SessionStart context
- feat(channel): support trusted context directories for channel workers
- feat(context): port upstream context-injection safeguards
- feat(workspace): protect parallel journal merges
- feat(i18n): translate user-facing command titles to Chinese
- chore(marketplace): sync platform/template support, including Grok, Kimi Code, Codex, and Snow updates

**Fixes (ported from upstream mindfold-ai/Trellis):**
- fix(update): preserve reintroduced templates in safe-file-delete (#425)
- fix(update): rename-dir merge must not clobber canonical target with stale source bytes (#447)
- fix(pi): write shared skills to `.agents/skills/` instead of private `.pi/skills/` (#447)

**Migrations:**
- rename-dir `.pi/skills` → `.agents/skills` for existing Pi installs

migrations.description: Pi Agent: move installed skills from the private `.pi/skills/` root to the shared `.agents/skills/` root also used by Codex and Gemini CLI.
migrations.reason: Pi already discovers `.agents/skills/` natively, so keeping a separate `.pi/skills/` copy of the same Trellis skills caused Pi to see the same skill twice (once from each root) when Codex or Gemini was also installed (#447).

notes: No forced --migrate for breaking changes. On `trellis update --migrate`, legacy `.pi/skills/` is relocated into `.agents/skills/` when safe. Supported npm global installs create the Claude compatibility link on a best-effort basis; `--ignore-scripts`, Windows or platforms without a safe directory-fd path such as `/proc/self/fd`, and uninstall cleanup remain documented limitations.
